documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For Period Ended June 30, 2026.
JUBLCPL: Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Unsecured Creditors To Be Held On September 05, 2026.
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Equity Shareholders To Be Held On September 05, 2026.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, achieving consolidated revenue from operations of INR 18,911 million for FY26. Management announced that its polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, will commence operations in Q1 FY27. Adhesives demand remained strong during the period, driven by GST rate reductions and a recovery in discretionary spending, whereas replacement tyres and industrial polymers faced demand softness. Additionally, the Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of its Agri Business into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million for Q3 FY26, reflecting a 13% year-on-year growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial polymers, food polymers, and industrial chemicals experienced softness in demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial polymers, Food polymers and Industrial chemicals faced demand softness

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic construction demand continues to strengthen, supporting strong growth prospects.

demand_outlook.claim: Urban housing demand is being uplifted by rising renovations and modular furniture adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: Urban housing demand uplifted driven by rising renovations and modular furniture adoption

demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand both domestic and global in market

demand_outlook.claim: The overall agricultural outlook remains positive due to an above-normal monsoon, improved soil moisture, and healthy reservoir levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall outlook remains positive, supported by an above-normal monsoon, improved soil moisture, and healthy reservoir levels, which are expected to strengthen sowing activity and rural sentiment in the Rabi season

demand_outlook.claim: Adhesives growth prospects are supported by improving domestic demand in construction and allied sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising renovation activity and adoption of modular furniture are driving urban housing growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will commence its polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: A world-class R&D center at the Samlya plant facilitates the development of a new range of SBR latex.
capex_expansion.quote: World-class R&D center at the Samlya (Gujarat) plant facilitates the development of new range of SBR latex

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved setting up a manufacturing facility at Samlya, Vadodara to expand Performance Polymers manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved a capex of approximately Rs. 50 crore for setting up new manufacturing facilities at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion will be funded mostly through internal accruals and add 30,000 MT per annum to Performance Polymers capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
